mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, main_id,logistics_label_url
mapper.select: select distinct sb2c.id from so_b2c sb2c inner join so_b2c_logistics sbl on sb2c.id = sbl.main_id and sbl.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_delivery sbd on sb2c.id = sbd.source_id and sbd.is_deleted = false left join so_b2c_label sbl2 on sb2c.id = sbl2.main_id and sbl2.is_deleted = false where sbl2.id is null and sb2c.is_deleted = false and sbd.create_time >= #{startTime} and sbd.create_time < #{endTime} and sb2c.bill_status in ('inDistribution','waitShipped') and sbd.status not in ('cancelDelivery','shipped') and sbl.logistics_channel_id != '' and sbl.code != '' and sb2c.invalid_status = false and sbl.source_system = 'third' and NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 from so_b2c_error sbe where sbe.main_id = sb2c.id and sbe.type= 'getLogisticsLabel' and sbe.is_deleted = false )
